spans.text: Unit 5: Digital content
Streaming
Video, audio and games can be streamed.

Streaming is when a digital file is sent a few seconds at a time from the server. Streaming means users can start viewing or listening while the rest of the file is still being sent. Streamed content is automatically deleted once you play it.
Video, audio and games can be streamed live while an event is taking place. This is not possible when downloading files.
Downloading ...
LIVE STREAMING
Keywords
digital content: anything on a digital device that can be shared or distributed
streaming: sending digital content over the internet while it is being viewed or listened to
podcast: a digital audio file for streaming or downloading to a computer or mobile device
audio book: a recording of someone reading the text of a book or magazine

a Digital content can be stored on servers.
T

T
c Photographs are not stored on servers.
F
d Audio content only refers to music.
F
e Messages are a form of digital content that are stored on servers.
T
f Music can be streamed to someone’s car.
T
g Streamed content is automatically stored on the user’s device.
F
